units.source_text: 人们绞尽脑汁制定规则，然而又在钻规则的空子。

en.t: People rack their brains to make rules, yet they also look for loopholes in those rules.

units.source_text: 为了堵住狡诈的战术而制定了规则，

en.t: Rules are made in order to block cunning tactics,

units.source_text: 年轻棋手就不见得没人耍滑头想出一种战术来利用这些规则。

en.t: but among the young players there are bound to be some who slyly devise tactics to exploit those very rules.

units.source_text: 他们可以想出各种名堂，如限制时间、中途暂停、封盘等，作为武器使用。

en.t: They can come up with all sorts of devices, such as time limits, adjournments, and sealed moves, and use them as weapons.

units.source_text: 因此，作为作品的一局棋就变得不纯净了。

en.t: As a result, a game of go as a work of art becomes impure.

units.source_text: 名人一旦面对棋盘，很快变成了“往昔的人”。

en.t: Once the Master sat before the board, he quickly became a man of the past.

units.source_text: 他不知道当今各种细微的计策。

en.t: He did not know the many subtle stratagems of the present day.

units.source_text: 一直以来，名人大约估计正好是火候，是自己最合适的时机，

en.t: Until then, the Master would judge roughly when the moment was ripe, when it suited him best,

units.source_text: 便说声“今天到这里吧”，就让下手下一着，

en.t: then say, Let us stop here for today, and have the lower-ranked player make the next move,

units.source_text: 然后中途暂停，由自己来决定续弈的日子。

en.t: after which he would adjourn the game and decide for himself the day on which play would resume.

units.source_text: 上手这样妄自尊大，已成为一种理所当然的惯例，

en.t: Such arrogance on the part of the superior player had become an accepted custom,

units.source_text: 名人长期以来就是这样对局过来的，也没有时间的限制。

en.t: and for a long time the Master had played his games in this way, without any limit on time.

units.source_text: 允许名人这样妄自尊大，对名人也是一种锻炼。

en.t: Allowing the Master this kind of arrogance was also a form of training for him.

units.source_text: 这同今天那种完全凭着规则办事的狭隘做法恐怕不能相提并论。

en.t: This probably cannot be compared with today’s narrow way of doing everything strictly by the rules.
